name: SikaSeal-190 N Silicone
paste:
SIKASEAL®-190 N SILICONE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone, January 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sikaseal-190-n-silicone.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone is a one-component, neutral curing, low odour silicone sealant with excellent adhesion and is suitable for elastic joint sealing. SikaSeal®- 190 N Silicone is easy to apply and cures with atmospheric moisture to form a high performance tough flexible mould resistant seal for internal and external applications in movement and connection joints. SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone is available in a range of complimentary colours for SikaCeram®-690 Elite and SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Kitchens & Bathrooms
    - Showers & Tiled areas
    - Benchtops & Basins
    - Baths & Toilets
    - Movement & Connection joints
    - Around Splashbacks
    - Around plumbing fixtures and penetrations
    - General interior & exterior sealing around the home
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: HIGH FLEXIBILITY NEUTRAL CURE SANITARY SILICONE SEALANT
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - Green Building Council of Australia
    - Green Star Design & As Built V1.3-13.1.1B
    - Green Star Interiors V1.3-12.1.1B
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ISO 1183-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Density (p.1).
    - ASTM D3960: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Volatile organic compound (VOC) content (p.2).
    - ISO 868: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shore A hardness (p.2).
    - ISO 8339: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Secant tensile modulus (p.2).
    - ASTM C719: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Movement capability (p.2).
    - CQP 049-2: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where: Technical Information > Curing rate (p.2).
    - CQP 019-1: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where: Technical Information > Skinning time (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Neutral cure
    - Excellent adhesion to common construction materials: glass, enamel, porcelain, ceramic, tile, aluminium, concrete and grouts
    - Non-corrosive
    - Non-sag
    - Easy tooling characteristics
    - Mould resistant
    - Fast curing
    - Low VOC content
    - High movement capability ± 50%
    - High temperature resistance (-40°C to +150°C)
    - See Important Considerations below prior to use, Not suitable for all metal and natural stone substrates
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Neutral cure silicone
    - Colour: White, Jasmin, Jurra Beige, Havana, Silver Grey, Manhattan, Grey, Ash, Platinum Grey & Anthracite
    - Density: ~1.4 kg/l (ISO 1183-1)
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: 38 g/l (ASTM D3960)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Green building: Green Star Design & As Built V1.3-13.1.1B; Green Star Interiors V1.3-12.1.1B
    - Shore A hardness: ~35 (after 21 days) (ISO 868)
    - Tensile strength: ~0.6 MPa (ISO 37)
    - Secant tensile modulus: ~0.50 N/mm² at 100% elongation (23 °C) (ISO 8339)
    - Movement capability: ± 50% (ASTM C719)
    - Elongation at break: ~400% (ISO 37)
2.7 Service temperature.
    | Maximum | +150°C |
    | Minimum | -40°C |
2.8 Joint design. For movement joints, the width must be at least 6 mm and should not exceed 45 mm. For non-movement joints such as connection joints in interior areas, the joint width can be less than 6 mm. The joint dimensions must be designed to suit the movement capability of the sealant. In all cases joints must be at least 6 mm deep, or a have a width to depth ratio of 1 : 0.5. For more information about joint design and calculations refer to the Sika document Design guideline: Dimensioning of construction joints or contact Sika Technical Services.
2.9 Ambient air temperature.
    | Maximum | +40°C |
    | Minimum | +5°C |
2.10 Substrate temperature.
    | Maximum | +40°C |
    | Minimum | +5°C |
    Note: The substrate temperature must be +3°C above dew point temperature and free from frost and ice.
2.11 Curing rate.
    | ~3.5mm / 24 hours | At 23°C / 50 % R.H. |
    Test method printed: (CQP 049-2)
2.12 Skinning time.
    | ~20 minutes | At 23°C / 50 % R.H. |
    Test method printed: (CQP 019-1)
2.13 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 300ml cartridges
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
2.14 Storage conditions. The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. The substrate must be clean, dry, sound and free from oils, grease, dust, cement laitance and loose or friable particles. Remove all dust, loose and friable material from all surfaces before application of activators, primers or sealant. SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone adheres without primers and/or activators. For optimum adhesion, joint durability and critical, high performance applications the following priming and/or pre-treatment procedures must be followed, primers and activators are adhesion promoters and not an alternative to improve poor preparation/cleaning of the joint surface. The substrate should be of sufficient strength to withstand the stress induced by the sealant during movement. Use techniques such as wire brushing, grinding, grit blasting or other suitable mechanical methods to remove all weak substrate material. Repair all damaged joint edges with suitable Sika® repair products.
3.3 Non-porous substrates. Aluminium, anodised aluminium, stainless steel, galvanised steel and glazed tiles
    - Lightly roughen the surface with a fine abrasive pad.
    - Clean the surface.
    - Pretreat the surface using Sika® Aktivator-205 applied with lint-free paper towel.
    - Lightly roughen the surface with a fine abrasive pad. Clean the surface.
    - Pretreat the surface using Sika® Aktivator-205 with lint-free paper towel.
    - Allow a waiting time.
    - Apply Sika® Primer-3 N by brush
    Other metals, such as brass, bronze, and titanium-zinc
3.4 Non-porous substrates - Float glass, coated glass and Powder-coated metals.
    - Clean the surface.
    - Pretreat the surface using Sika® Aktivator-205 applied with lint-free paper towel.
3.5 Non-porous substrates - Pvc.
    - Clean the surface.
    - Pretreat the surface using Sika® Aktivator-205 applied with lint-free paper towel.
    - Prime surface using Sika® Primer-3 N applied by brush
    Porous substrates
    Concrete, aerated concrete and cement based renders, mortars and bricks.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - Masking
    - It is recommended to use masking tape where neat or exact joint lines are required. Remove the tape within the skin time after finishing.
4.3 Application method / tools - Joint Backing.
    - After the required substrate preparation, insert a suitable backing rod to the required depth. Priming
    - If required, prime the joint surfaces as recommended in substrate preparation. Avoid excessive application of primer causing puddles at the base of the joint. Refer to Product Data Sheets for necessary flash off times.
    - Application
    - SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone is supplied ready to use. Prepare the cartridge, insert into the sealant gun and fit the nozzle, trim nozzle to suit joint width. Extrude sealant into the joint ensuring that it comes into full contact with the sides of the joint and avoiding any air entrapment.
    - Finishing
    - As soon as possible after application, sealant must be firmly tooled against the joint sides to ensure adequate adhesion and a smooth finish. Use a compatible water based non-staining tooling agent (e.g. Sika® Tooling Agent N) to smooth the joint surface. Do not use tooling products containing solvents.
4.4 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with Sika® Remover-208 immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically. For cleaning skin, use Sika® Cleaner 350H.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - When applying sealant into a previously silicone sealed joint, ensure all residue is removed from joint.
    - SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone cannot be overpainted.
    - Do not use on natural stone.
    - Do not use on bituminous substrates, natural rubber or materials which might leach oils, plasticisers or solvents that could degrade the sealant.
    - EPDM or other gaskets in direct contact must be tested for compatibility prior to application.
    - Pre-test prior to use on prestressed polyacrylate and polycarbonate as it may cause environmental stress cracking (crazing).
    - Pre-test in an inconspicuous area prior to use on porous material such as concrete to ensure the product does not stain the substrate.
    - Do not use SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone in areas which are exposed to strong oxidising acids (e.g. nitric acid) and bases.
    - Do not use to seal joints in or around swimming pools, joints under water pressure or permanent water immersion.
    - Do not use SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone in totally confinedspaces as it requires atmospheric moisture to cure.
    - Colour variations may occur due to the exposure in service to chemicals, high temperatures and/or UV radiation (especially with white colour shade). This effect is aesthetic and does not adversely influence the technical performance or durability of the product.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.5):
    - Do not use SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone in totally confinedspaces as it requires atmospheric moisture to cure.
    - Colour variations may occur due to the exposure in service to chemicals, high temperatures and/or UV radiation (especially with white colour shade). This effect is aesthetic and does not adversely influence the technical performance or durability of the product.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Pre-test prior to use on prestressed polyacrylate and polycarbonate as it may cause environmental stress cracking (crazing).
    - Pre-test in an inconspicuous area prior to use on porous material such as concrete to ensure the product does not stain the substrate.
5.4 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Density: ~1.4 kg/l (ISO 1183-1)
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: 38 g/l (ASTM D3960)
    - Shore A hardness: ~35 (after 21 days) (ISO 868)
    - Tensile strength: ~0.6 MPa (ISO 37)
    - Secant tensile modulus: ~0.50 N/mm² at 100% elongation (23 °C) (ISO 8339)
    - Movement capability: ± 50% (ASTM C719)
    - Elongation at break: ~400% (ISO 37)
    - Curing rate: ~3.5mm / 24 hours | At 23°C / 50 % R.H. (CQP 049-2)
    - Skinning time: ~20 minutes | At 23°C / 50 % R.H. (CQP 019-1)
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaSeal®-190 N Silicone, January 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sikaseal-190-n-silicone.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaSeal - 190 N Silicone, version 18/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/SDS%20SikaSeal%20-%20190%20N%20Silicone%20GHS7.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaCeram and SikaSeal Colour Partner Selection Card.pdf, version 19/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/SikaCeram%20and%20SikaSeal%20Colour%20Partner%20Selection%20Card.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (January 2026, Version 01.01).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
